text:
tamara.se: FYI HeliumCare just sent an RFP. Main asks: 2-week POC, capability matrix (hosted vs dedicated vs private), security questionnaire, and pricing for a 6-month pilot. They also want a runbook for onboarding and a short SLA for latency.

 omar.se: Thanks. Any regulatory constraints? HIPAA, data residency?

 tamara.se: HIPAA + EU PHI controls (they operate in EU + US). Also asked if we support customer-managed KMS and HSM.

 lex.eng: We do support customer KMS for Private and Dedicated via CloudHSM/Azure HSM. For Hosted we offer our managed KMS but can set up BYOK via a key wrap workflow. Will document encryption-at-rest and transit.

 nick.pricing: Pilot term pricing question: are they looking for committed GPU hours or token-based billing? If GPU, need the perf target to size.

 tamara.se: They prefer predictable cost, so leaning toward reserved capacity with overage. Said they want P95 <300ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens) and throughput for bursts up to 60 RPS.

 lex.eng: For that latency/throughput, recommend Dedicated with 2x A10xP or Dedicated A100 pair depending on model size. Private on customer infra is possible but will add setup time. I'll run a quick benchmark with 2x A10xP and share numbers.

 sec-bot: Uploaded file: heliumcare_security_questions_v1.xlsx (https://drive.redwood/heliumcare/secq_v1).

 julia.legal: Heads up on export controls: if customer data contains EU PHI, we need data processing addendum and standard contractual clauses plus SCC replacement language. I'll draft.

 omar.se: Can we provide a capability matrix row for "data egress controls" and "audit log delivery (SIEM integration)"? They want logs forwarded to Splunk.

 lex.eng: Yes. We have per-tenant audit streaming to S3 and Splunk HTTP Event Collector. For Private, logs remain local. Will add integration steps to the runbook.

 nick.pricing: I'll prepare two pricing scenarios: (A) Reserved baseline for pilot (30k tokens/day + 4 reserved GPU-hours/day) and (B) Token-based with burst cap. Will include cached vs uncached assumptions.

 tamara.se: Also they asked about model governance: how we handle model version pinning, rollbacks, and eval hooks. Include that in the matrix.

 lex.eng: Add rows for model pinning, canary rollouts, automatic fallback to smaller model, and quality monitoring (prompt set evals). We have an autoscale policy template for pilots.

 julia.legal: For HSM answers, provide supported vendors and FIPS levels. sec-bot, do we have an HSM FAQ template?

 sec-bot: HSM template link: https://drive.redwood/templates/hsm_faq.md. Supports AWS CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault HSM, and PKCS#11 on-prem connectors. FIPS 140-2/3 guidance included.

 omar.se: Can someone draft the quick SOW bullets for the 2-week POC? Need acceptance criteria.

 lex.eng: Draft SOW bullets: 1) Deploy infra (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) 2) Integrate SSO + Splunk logging 3) Run 3 smoke tests and 2 stress tests 4) Deliver perf report + recommended config 5) Knowledge transfer session. Acceptance: smoke latency p95 <350ms; 80% of eval prompts pass; logs delivered to Splunk.

 nick.pricing: For TCO, I will show 3-month extrapolated numbers and a per-request cost. Also include potential savings from prefix caching (estimate 20% token reduction) and batching.

 tamara.se: Ops question: how long to spin up a Dedicated pool for pilot?

 ops-bot: Typical provisioning time: 4-6 hours for Dedicated reserved capacity in our hosted region. Private on-prem install: 3-5 business days (depends on customer infra & approvals).

 lex.eng: For the runbook I'll include a minimal k8s spec, required ports, and an airgap checklist for Private. Also a `wrk` script example: ``wrk -t12 -c100 -d60s --latency http://localhost:8080/generate`` to reproduce.

 julia.legal: I'll prepare the DPA + SCC draft and flag any negotiation points. Also confirm SOC2 scope for hosted.

 tamara.se: Action items: lex to run perf and update matrix (tomorrow AM); nick to draft pricing table & TCO (EOD Thu); julia to draft DPA + export control notes (EOD Wed); omar to compile RFP packet and schedule a 30m review Fri 11am.

 lex.eng: A note on model sizes: what model family are they evaluating? Small Llama variants or larger? That affects GPU choice.

 tamara.se: They mentioned testing with a 13B open-model and a larger 70B for quality checks.

 nick.pricing: 70B increases memory needs and may push us to H100-class hardware for acceptable latency. I'll model both 13B and 70B costs.

 omar.se: I'll pull all links into a single Google folder and invite the customer to a workspace for asset sharing.

 sec-bot: Uploaded file: heliumcare_poc_runbook_draft.md (https://drive.redwood/heliumcare/runbook_d1).

 tamara.se: Thanks team. Please flag any blockers in thread. Meeting invite Fri 11am sent. :calendar:

 nick.pricing: I might be OOO Fri morning, will send draft by Thu evening.

 lex.eng: I'll post perf numbers tomorrow and attach trace screenshots.

 end of thread
